about: An event arrives by name from outside the document, so the names it can arrive under are open: a transition on `request` takes `request` and every name that extends it past a `.` (`request.new`, `request.new.more`) whether or not the document writes them, the longest descriptor the document writes decides which transition (`request.special.deep` is `request.special`'s, which comes first), and a name that merely begins with the same letters, or is a prefix of a descriptor, is taken by none. Expected values are derived from the document and from W3C SCXML 3.12.1, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: an extension the document never writes: `request` is a token prefix of `request.new`
the other descriptor, written, and an extension of it that is not: it comes first in the document, so it takes both
`requesty` begins with the same letters but is another token: no descriptor of the document matches it, so it is dropped
a prefix of a descriptor is no extension of it, and is dropped the same
